_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The conversation table of contents popover opens from its nav button, lists entries, and dismisses. "The button" is ".toc-button"; "the popover" is ".toc-popover". Accessible names: an element's name is its aria-label if it has one; otherwise a button's name is its text with whitespace collapsed and trimmed, leaving out aria-hidden parts, and a dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to; "named X" means the name is exactly X. Only elements that are not display: none count. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The button should be visible (allow 30s), with aria-expanded="false" and accessible name exactly "Conversation table of contents". 3. Click it: the popover and its ".toc-popover-list" should be visible, the button should have aria-expanded="true", and ".toc-popover-title" should have exactly the text "Jump to…". 4. The popover's first ".toc-entry" should contain "Top of conversation", its last ".toc-entry" should contain "End of conversation", and its first ".toc-entry-user" should contain "echo table of contents". 5. Press Escape: the popover should be hidden and the button should have aria-expanded="false". 6. Click the button: the popover should be visible. Click ".messages-container" 10 pixels right and 10 pixels down from its top-left corner: the popover should be hidden. 7. Click the button: the popover should be visible. Click its first ".toc-entry-user": the popover should be hidden, and location.hash should come to match /^#m-[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/ (poll for up to 5s).

steps.expression: (() => { const e = [...document.querySelectorAll(".toc-popover .toc-entry")]; return e.length > 0 && e[0].textContent.includes("Top of conversation"); })()
(() => { const e = [...document.querySelectorAll(".toc-popover .toc-entry")]; return e.length > 0 && e[e.length - 1].textContent.includes("End of conversation"); })()
